  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω)),
  LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k s => s k) ↑μ ↑P →
    ∀ (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n → ℝ) (g : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n → Ω → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n) (σ : ℝ),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n) Ω (↑μ) f g σ →
        Measurable (gradient f) →
          ∀ (β : ℝ),
            0 ≤ β →
              β < 1 →
                ∀ (B : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ B →
                    ∀ (W : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
                      (∀ (t : ℕ), Measurable (W t)) →
                        (∀ (t : ℕ) (s s' : ℕ → Ω), (∀ j < t * B, s j = s' j) → W t s = W t s') →
                          ∀ (D : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
                            (∀ (s : ℕ → Ω),
                                D 0 s =
                                  (1 / ↑B) • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, g (W 0 s) (s (0 * B + j)) - gradient f (W 0 s)) →
                              (∀ (t : ℕ) (s : ℕ → Ω),
                                  D (t + 1) s =
                                    β • D t s +
                                      (1 - β) •
                                        ((1 / ↑B) • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, g (W (t + 1) s) (s ((t + 1) * B + j)) -
                                          gradient f (W (t + 1) s))) →
                                ∀ (t : ℕ),
                                  Measurable (D t) ∧
                                    (∀ (s s' : ℕ → Ω), (∀ j < (t + 1) * B, s j = s' j) → D t s = D t s') ∧
                                      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun s => ‖D t s‖ ^ 2) ↑P ∧
                                        ∫ (s : ℕ → Ω), ‖D t s‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P ≤
                                          σ ^ 2 / ↑B * ((1 - β) / (1 + β) + (1 - (1 - β) / (1 + β)) * β ^ (2 * t))
